discovered_by: Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh 2020, the doubling construction, applied to the Williamson quadruple n11-cd1f64808fe4c9afa60d of length 11 on this board, whose discovery is credited on its own entry; rows generated by tools/construct_even_williamson.py and stored in canonical form

sources.title: Bright, Kotsireas, Ganesh, Applying computer algebra systems with SAT solvers to the Williamson conjecture, J. Symbolic Comput. 100 (2020), Section 2.6: the doubling construction

notes: n = 2 x 11. With A, B, C, D the rows of n11-cd1f64808fe4c9afa60d, the rows are A x B', (-A) x B', C x D', (-C) x D', where x interleaves two sequences and X' is X shifted cyclically to the palindromic position.
